title: Write through a Docker bind mount
description: Recorded tutorial bind-mount commands in an isolated Docker sandbox. The image tag is pinned. The shared directory starts empty.

commands: docker run --rm -v "$HOME/agents/work:/work" alpine:3.20 sh -c 'touch /work/hello && echo wrote'

markers.title: Create the shared directory
markers.note: You create a directory in the demo home.

markers.title: Mount the directory
markers.note: The container lists the shared directory. It starts empty.

markers.title: Write from the container
markers.note: The container creates hello through the mount.

markers.title: Check from the host
markers.note: The host-side listing shows the shared file.
